ModMetaData.name: Dynamic Mending
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description: Repair damaged apparel and weapons at a manual or electric mending table, or a fully automated hopper-fed mending station at higher tech. Material and work-time costs scale dynamically with missing HP, and failed or risky repairs can cost HP or item quality. Requires Biotech and Vanilla Recycling Expanded: repair work always produces real waste byproducts (Wastepacks and recyclable trash) as a core mechanic, not an optional extra.
